user.title: Device Panel
user.description: Adds the Device Panel to the sidebar: all devices with outages, availability and software version.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Device Panel is already set up.

init.title: Settings
init.description: The same settings are available in the panel (gear icon), together with updates. Integrations with battery devices: {battery_domains}.

data.battery_push_mode: Battery: time of the push notification
data.battery_fields: Battery: content of the push notification
data.new_fields: New devices: content of the push notification
data.offline_after_integrations: Offline after: own value per integration
data.battery_low_integrations: Battery: own warning threshold per integration
data.hide_connections: Hide filter chips of the connection type
data.connection_order: Order of the connection type chips
data.ai_assessment: AI assessment: show the button in the device pop-up
data.ai_task_entity: AI task for the assessment (empty = default of Home Assistant)
data.signal_low: Signal: warning threshold per connection type
data.signal_low_integrations: Signal: warning threshold per connection type and integration

data_description.notify_service: notify service or notify entity, e.g. the Companion app of your phone.
data_description.notify_click_target: Where tapping a push notification about a device leads.
data_description.offline_after: Minutes without a sign of life before a device counts as offline. Shorter dropouts are not counted.
data_description.notify_delay: Minutes of outage before the push is sent; at least "Offline after" (before that a device does not count as offline). Shorter outages send neither an outage nor a back online notification.
data_description.flaky_outages: An online device with this many outages in the last 24 hours is listed as unstable.
data_description.startup_grace: Minutes after Home Assistant starts in which returning devices had no outage. Time when Home Assistant was not running never counts as an outage.
data_description.notify_outage: Once a device counts as offline and "Report outages only after" has passed, to the push target above.
data_description.notify_online: All clear as soon as the device is back, with the duration of the outage.
data_description.notify_group: From 3 devices at once one notification with the probable cause instead of many.
data_description.outage_persistent: One notification in Home Assistant listing all devices that are offline right now; it disappears once all are back.
data_description.notify_fields: Details below the device name in the outage notification ("Offline: …"); the low battery push has its own content (field further below). Buttons: open, mute 24 h (companion app).
data_description.battery_low: A battery at or below this level counts as low (red in the panel, under "Warnings").
data_description.battery_push: Once per device when it drops below the warning threshold, to the push target above. Again only after the battery was 5 points above the warning threshold (e.g. new battery).
data_description.battery_push_mode: Immediately when a device drops below the warning threshold, or once a day at the time below.
data_description.battery_push_time: Local time of the daily notification.
data_description.battery_push_daily: Only devices that became low since the last notification, or every day all devices with a low battery (reminder).
data_description.battery_persistent: One notification in Home Assistant listing all devices with a low battery; it disappears once all are above the warning threshold again.
data_description.battery_fields: Details below the device name in the low battery push ("Battery low: …"); the daily or group notification lists them in brackets after each device. Nothing selected: the level.
data_description.notify_new: A push notification when a new device appears in Home Assistant (only devices that appear after you switch this on), to the push target above.
data_description.new_window: Minutes to wait after the first new device, so that more devices (for example a new integration) arrive in one notification and area and model are known.
data_description.new_persistent: One notification in Home Assistant with the devices found last; it stays until you dismiss it.
data_description.new_fields: Details below the device name in the push ("New device: …"); the group notification lists them in brackets after each device. Nothing selected: the integration.
data_description.offline_after_integrations: Integration → minutes or off, one per line, e.g. "zha: 60" or "hue: off" (off: devices stay visible but are not monitored: no outages, statistics or notifications). Without an entry the global value applies; the device's primary integration counts.
data_description.notify_exclude_integrations: No outage and back online push for devices of these integrations; they are still monitored.
data_description.persistent_exclude_integrations: Devices of these integrations do not appear in the persistent notification for outages.
data_description.battery_low_integrations: Integration → percent or off, one per line, e.g. "zha: 25" or "bthome: off" (warning off for this integration). Without an entry the global value (field above) applies; the device's primary integration counts.
data_description.battery_push_exclude_integrations: No low battery push for devices of these integrations; the red mark in the panel and the persistent notification stay.
data_description.new_exclude_integrations: No push for new devices of these integrations (for example Bluetooth trackers that create devices all the time).
data_description.exclude_integrations: Devices of these integrations are not shown in the panel and not monitored.
data_description.exclude_types: Devices of these types are not shown in the panel and not monitored. The type of a single device can be changed in its pop-up.
data_description.exclude_devices: Devices that are neither shown nor monitored and send no notifications. In the panel: button "Hide" in the device pop-up.
data_description.show_service_devices: Services of an integration rather than real devices, e.g. sun, weather forecast or add-ons. Shown service devices are monitored too.
data_description.show_disabled_devices: In their own group at the end of the list. They are not monitored.
data_description.hide_chips: Hides single chips above the list: area, integration, offline, warnings, battery, low battery, weak signal, update available, own setting, new. The devices stay visible; an active filter of a hidden chip is cleared. "All" always stays. Applies to all users.
data_description.hide_connections: Only the connection type chips above the list; the devices stay visible. Applies to all users.
data_description.connection_order: Starting order of the connection type chips, in the order of selection; types not chosen follow by number of devices. Empty = by number of devices. Applies until chips are dragged in the panel (Settings › Display › Filter chips), which stores the order of all chips.
data_description.connection_integrations: Integration → connection type, one per line, e.g. "hue: zigbee". Applies to all devices of the integration instead of the detection; a connection type set by hand on the device comes first. Types: zigbee, thread, zwave, matter, ble, wifi, ethernet, network, cloud.
data_description.ai_assessment: Without this switch the pop-up has no button. Only on a button press the panel sends name, area and values of that one device (no keys, no credentials) to the AI task; depending on the provider they leave your network.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Optional. Leave empty to use the default AI task of Home Assistant (Settings → System → General).
data_description.update_check: Reports a new version under Settings → Repairs. Pre-releases are never reported here.
data_description.signal_low: Connection type → threshold, one per line, e.g. "wifi: -85", "zigbee: 40" or "ble: off" (dBm negative, LQI positive). Applies to devices without an own setting; unset = standard (-80 dBm, LQI 60).
data_description.signal_low_integrations: Integration → connection type → threshold, e.g. "shelly:" with "wifi: -88" and "ble: off" below it. Goes before the global value; a device setting goes before both.

error.offline_map: Each line must be integration: whole number from 1 to 1440 or off (e.g. "zha: 60", "hue: off").
error.battery_map: Each line must be integration: whole number from 5 to 50 or off (e.g. "zha: 25", "bthome: off").
error.connection_map: Each line must be integration: connection type (zigbee, thread, zwave, matter, ble, wifi, ethernet, network, cloud).
error.notify_delay_short: "Report outages only after" must not be shorter than "Offline after": before that a device does not count as offline.
error.signal_map: Each line must be a connection type (e.g. wifi, ble, zigbee) and off or a number: dBm from -110 to -40, LQI from 1 to 200.
error.signal_integrations_map: Each integration must contain connection types with off or a number: dBm from -110 to -40, LQI from 1 to 200.

update_available.title: Device Panel {latest} is available
update_available.description: Installed is {installed}. Update via HACS or via the gear icon in the Device Panel (Settings). The daily check can be turned off in the options of the integration.
